title: Console installation manifest
responsibility: Reads and writes the host’s console installation record, retaining file ownership and change history.

inputs.name: consoleManifest.host
inputs.description: Host project directory; the record is read from harness.console.json inside it, built with node:path join. Any read failure, including a missing directory or file, returns an empty record instead of rejecting, so a wrong host looks like a fresh install.

inputs.name: writeConsoleManifest.host
inputs.description: Host project directory that receives harness.console.json, built with node:path join; the directory must already exist because the write does not create it, and a missing or unwritable directory rejects the call.

inputs.name: writeConsoleManifest.manifest
inputs.description: Installation record to serialize; its files array is copied and sorted by path before writing, while changes and every other field, including schemaVersion, are written as given without validation.

changes.reason: file is no longer part of the console bundle

outputs.name: consoleManifestFile
outputs.description: Constant file name harness.console.json, joined to the host directory by both functions; it is exported rather than passed in, so every host uses the same name.

outputs.name: consoleManifest
outputs.description: Parsed installation record: schemaVersion is always 1, missing or null files and changes become empty arrays, and a files entry without an owner gets owner harness. A read failure or a zero-length file returns an empty record; malformed JSON rejects with SyntaxError, and a null document, a files value that is neither an array nor null, or a null files entry rejects with TypeError.

changes.reason: file is no longer part of the console bundle

outputs.name: writeConsoleManifest
outputs.description: Resolves once harness.console.json in host has been overwritten with tab-indented JSON, a trailing newline and files sorted by path. The file is written in place, not through a temp file, so a failed write can leave it truncated or partly written, and a missing or unwritable host directory rejects.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse inside consoleManifest when harness.console.json exists but its text is not valid JSON; consoleManifest rejects with it and does not modify the file.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown inside consoleManifest when the stored document is null, when files is neither an array nor null, or when a files entry is null, because the code reads those values without type checks; consoleManifest rejects with it.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Node.js filesystem error (a plain Error whose code is ENOENT, EACCES, ENOSPC or similar) that writeConsoleManifest rejects with when harness.console.json cannot be written in host, for example because the directory is missing or not writable.
